name: Silence Foe (Combat)
body:
You can steal an opponent’s voice with a well placed strike.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you deal sneak attack damage to a target you can choose to roll 2 fewer dice than normal to render your opponent unable to speak for 1 round unless they succeed at a Fortitude save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + the number of sneak attack dice you possess.
